metadata.title: COBO L1 macOS Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: Operating system–specific System Security and Privacy Plan defining how Apple macOS endpoints implement the COBO L1 baseline endpoint trust tier.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: An Apple macOS endpoint configured and managed to meet the baseline COBO L1 institutional endpoint trust requirements for general-purpose use.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: This macOS SSPP inherits all trust requirements from the COBO L1 Endpoint SSPP.

props.name: supported-versions
props.remarks: Only currently supported macOS versions approved by the institution are permitted.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: macOS endpoint is owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: macOS endpoint is centrally enrolled and governed using institutional device management services (MDM).

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: macOS endpoint identity must use Secure Enclave–backed private keys and PKI-issued device certificates.

props.name: cryptographic-compliance
props.remarks: macOS cryptographic operations must rely on platform cryptographic services operating in FIPS 140-3–validated modes where applicable.

props.name: secure-boot
props.remarks: Apple Secure Boot and system integrity protections must be enabled.

props.name: system-integrity-protection
props.remarks: System Integrity Protection (SIP) must be enabled to prevent unauthorized modification of protected system locations.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: macOS configuration applies the CIS macOS Benchmark Level 1 settings.

props.name: malware-and-threat-protection
props.remarks: Apple XProtect, Gatekeeper, and approved endpoint threat protection tooling must be enabled.

props.name: posture-and-health-reporting
props.remarks: macOS endpoints continuously report posture and compliance signals to Secure Endpoint consumers.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: macOS COBO L1 endpoints may participate in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1 and 2.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Endpoint assurance does not grant automatic entitlement to any data classification.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: macOS endpoints must support Secure Endpoint lifecycle workflows including enrollment, suspension, recovery, and retirement.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP defines how macOS endpoints realize COBO L1 trust requirements using Apple platform security features, centralized management, and configuration baselines.

control-implementation.remarks: macOS security profiles, configuration profiles, MDM policies, and CIS-aligned baselines implement this SSPP and are maintained as version-controlled implementation artifacts.
